text:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock the scouting + scope tradeoffs for the next design partner round. Proposal: 2-week sourcing window, 3-week pilot. Need agreement on acceptance criteria, bandwidth limits, and rollback triggers.

Asha (Design): +1 to shorter sourcing. UX ask: require a 3hr onboarding session + weekly 30m check-in. Screener should ask 'approx monthly inference calls' to size effort.

Sam (Eng): FYI engineering capacity: we can support 5 partners concurrently on Dedicated. For Private/on-prem requests we add ~3w lead time. Need to pin models behind feature flags and enable request-level tracing.

Kai (Research): For quality gates I propose a 12-prompt eval set + automated regression harness. Gate: mean MRR drop <= 1% vs baseline or else rollback. Need tagging to run partner-specific evals.

Rishi (CS): Support constraints: define SLA during pilot — response target 4 business hours for P1/P2. Also we need an onboarding runbook and an escalation path to Eng oncall.

Maria (Sales): Prioritize partners in fintech & health for outreach (higher ARR & compliance needs). If partner requests Private, sales can commit to longer lead but must flag ARR.

Elaine (PM): Tradeoff note: Private deployments increase ship time and require legal + KMS. Do we accept longer lead for high-ARR partners? Need product + sales thumbs up.

Sam (Eng): Private requires KMS integration + extra infra checklist (HSM optional). Recommend we only invite partners with signed NDA & basic infra readiness.

Asha (Design): Draft screener — keep it tiny. Example:```
- contact_email: string
- monthly_tokens: number (approx)
- has_sso: boolean
- requires_onprem: boolean
- primary_use_case: select
``` Also add one UX consent checkbox for data collection.

Kai (Research): Also suggest a canary stage: 1 week with limited traffic + monitored evals before full pilot. Helps catch regressions early.

recruit-bot: New applicant received: Acme Health — requires on-prem, monthly_tokens=2,000,000, contact=jamie@acmehealth.com. Form fields attached.

Elaine (PM): Nice — @Maria can you score Acme on ARR and legal velocity? @Sam please list infra blockers for on-prem. We'll triage in Thurs 10am sync to finalize the acceptance rubric.

onboard-bot: Draft doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/beta-sourcing-rubric — permissions granted to product/design/eng/research.

Sam (Eng): Heads up: telemetry required for pilots — please ensure request_id + trace_id are present, and enable token-level cost logs.

Rishi (CS): I'll start a condensed runbook template (1 pager) for partner support handoff. Will post before Thurs. :thumbsup:

Asha (Design): I'll update the screener and attach sample onboarding flow.

Elaine (PM): Great — agenda for Thurs: acceptance rubric, support SLA, canary plan, and priority list. If anyone has blockers DM me. Thanks all :rocket:
